narrative.details: adventurer, Anastasia Hartwell has a task for someone of your talents.  Speak with her in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity, and prepare yourself for your first task for the mages of the Forsaken.
narrative.offerRewardText: Greetings, adventurer. You were wise to answer my call, and wiser still if you heed what I next say...

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 10, 935 XP in all.

quests.name: The Balnir Farmstead
quests.objectiveText: Bring Balnir Snapdragons to Anastasia Hartwell in the Mage Quarter of the Undercity.
